reviews.title: Actually worked, and probably the best of the rewards app
reviews.text:
I grinded some mobile games with the offerwall and managed to cash out 30 dollars as Steam giftcards with the coins I got in like 5 days. I did spend a lot of free time playing the games though, so it'll probably take a bit longer to accrue the same amounts of coins if you're short on time. All I really did was reach some specific level on some puzzle games, like level 100/200. Didn't have to pay anything besides watch ads. The amount of coins/money you get on here for doing each task actually feels significant too. There's also a decent selection of giftcards, including retailers and amazon, which is nice.

Only complaint I have is that when I redeemed the gift cards, it took about 2 days to arrive.

I'll definitely continue using this app since it actually feels like I get a good amount of money for doing the tasks unlike a large majority of the other rewards apps. 

I recommend playing the puzzle games with the levels btw, they're easier to gauge how long it'll take to reach certain rewards
